title: Group names disappear after applying a theme in demo mode
description: When a theme is applied in demo mode, the names of the groups are no longer displayed.
steps: Tap on the 'Preview' button for the 'Every Night' theme.
Observe that the group names ('Group 1', 'Group 2', 'Group 3') are no longer visible.
actual: The group names are not displayed on the screen after applying a theme in demo mode. The layout shows empty space where the names should be.
expected: The group names should be visible and correctly displayed on the screen, even after applying a theme in demo mode.
